rows.label: Five ARTH courses at the 2000 or 3000 level (one at 2000, two at 3000), at least 15 credits
rows.note: One pool so the caps can see all five courses: at least one 2000-level and two 3000-level courses, at least 15 credits. The page allows 3000-level or above; the board counts 2000-3999 only, the stricter reading. ARTH 1100 is not counted. The board also counts at most two transfer-credit courses (study abroad arrives as transfer credit), the stricter reading of the study abroad cap; shared-plus-abroad is confirmed separately.

rows.label: Get Director of Undergraduate Studies approval for any counted course not coded or cross-listed with ARTH or VISST
rows.note: The board counts only ARTH-coded courses; confirm any other course with the DUS.

rows.label: ARTH 1100 is the only course below the 2000 level that may count; confirm with the department how it fits the five courses
rows.note: The board does not count ARTH 1100 toward the five courses.

rows.label: No more than two minor courses may be double-counted toward your major or come from study abroad (check both together)
rows.note: The board enforces the cap of two shared courses with a major, and counts at most two transfer-credit courses (study abroad arrives as transfer credit). The combined total of shared and study abroad courses is confirmed here.

rows.label: Earn a B- or better in every course counted toward the minor
Submit the minor application form from the History of Art department and plan the minor with its coordinator or DUS
